test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A cube is painted on all surfaces with orange color and is divided into 27 equal cubes. How many cubes will have only one face painted?
solution:
Given,

A cube is painted Orange on all surfaces and then the cube cuts into 27 small cubes of equal part.

So, it has been cut into: 3 × 3 × 3.

Here, n = 3.

Now, using formula: (n - 2)² × 6

⇒ (n - 2)2 × 6

⇒ (3 - 2)2 × 6

⇒ 12 × 6

⇒ 1 × 6 = 6.

So, total '6' cubes will have only one face painted.

Hence, the correct answer is **"6"**.
